checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: play the soft UI cue on every navigation and modal control that is currently silent

impact_assessment.why: Some navigation actions play the 440Hz UI tone (Episode index, Enter, profile, reset) while How to play, the brand/back arrows, pause and the dialog X are silent. A played probe with music off will show zero tones for those controls, so the interface sounds inconsistent for the same class of action.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every screen transition and dialog open/close gives the same quiet confirmation, matching the existing action sound without new assets or volume changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: add playUi calls to six existing handlers; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; audio only, no visual or save change; preview screenshot modes must stay silent because the calls sit in click/key handlers, not the modal functions.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Instrumented played probe for How to play, dialog close, Episode index, Back, brand home, pause and game back; before/after tone logs; a full 18-level run; and the no-context audio tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: playUi added to How to play, modal close, back/brand home, game back, profile back, pause button and Escape pause; preview modes stay silent; README and ADR-025

[3/3] Verified: npm test 107/107; aikit check 5/5; music-off probe now logs [440] for howto, close, back, brand, profile back, pause and game back where before was silent; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-17-ui-cues' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit keyboard-only play, forced colors, reduced motion and 320px layouts; ship a fix only for a reproducible defect

impact_assessment.why: After seventeen change cycles, the interaction surface needs a fresh end-to-end accessibility and responsive sweep rather than another feature: keyboard focus order, forced-colors legibility, reduced-motion behavior and 320px overflow have only been checked piecemeal.
impact_assessment.benefits: A recorded pass/fail matrix for the full surface either proves the current state or isolates the next real defect; no speculative code change ships without a reproducer.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none unless a defect appears; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: read-only probes plus temp saves; audit screenshots only, no product edits.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keyboard-only First Light clear, forced-colors captures of title/chambers/game/profile/how-to/victory, reduced-motion animation and victory-delay measurements, 320px scroll-width checks on every screen, then the canonical test and AIKit gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Audited: keyboard-only First Light clear, reduced motion 0.001s, 320px no overflow; found forced-colors audio toggles invisible and replaced them with native checkboxes at 24x24 via an input[type=checkbox] override; README and ADR-026

[3/3] Verified: npm test 107/107; aikit check 5/5; forced-colors profile before empty pills, after native checked boxes; Music off visibly unchecked; keyboard/reduced-motion/320px passes; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-18-a11y-audit' completed successfully.

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 18 found and fixed the only audit defect. A post-fix sweep is needed to confirm no regression in keyboard, forced colors, reduced motion, mobile touch or save recovery before declaring the improvement run complete.
impact_assessment.benefits: Either a new reproducible defect is caught and fixed, or the record closes with a full zero-finding cycle and evidence for every audited surface.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none expected; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: temp saves only; audit screenshots only unless a defect appears.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keyboard profile edit, forced-colors portal live/idle comparison, 390x844 touch Double Down clear, corrupt and future save checks, reduced-motion durations, canonical tests and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: let wide chambers pan horizontally at a 28px cell floor on narrow screens instead of shrinking to 16px/12.8px targets, with an orientation hint

impact_assessment.why: Crosscurrent is 21x7 and currently fills the phone width, producing 16.2px cells at 390x844 and 12.8px at 320x568, below the 24px target floor and error-prone for taps. The whole board fits at 29px cells in landscape, but portrait needs either a rotate prompt or a pannable board.
impact_assessment.benefits: Portrait players get 28px cells and a swipeable board with a visible 'Swipe / rotate' hint; landscape keeps the whole 29px-cell board. Normal and tall boards keep their current sizing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: board and beam layer move into a scroll stage; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save change; layout: the board frame stays full width while the stage can be wider, and the beam SVG must fill the stage so paths stay aligned.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure wideBoardNeedsPan cases, stage/cell measurements at 390 portrait and 844 landscape, beam alignment screenshots, a real Crosscurrent tap clear in portrait, a non-wide Confluence regression check, and the 18-level run.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented: board viewport/stage wrapper, wideBoardNeedsPan with three tests, 28px stage floor on compact wide boards, swipe/rotate hint, beam inset alignment, minmax grid containment, README and ADR-027

[3/4] Verified: npm test 110/110; aikit check 5/5; Crosscurrent 28px cells at 390 and 320, hint visible, page width unchanged, landscape 29.1px no hint, 9-tap portrait clear 3 stars; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'mobile-wide-pan' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: height-fit the 23-row Confluence on phones at a 24px cell floor, keeping the page-scroll fallback when the floor cannot fit

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the Confluence board is 340x711 starting at y=264 and ending at 974, 130px below the fold; at 320x568 it ends at 867, 299px below. The player cannot see both ends of the relay while solving, and the 24px floor is already guaranteed by the README.
impact_assessment.benefits: At 390 the whole 11x23 relay fits in the viewport at about 24px cells; at 320 the board keeps 24px cells and the existing page scroll remains the fallback. Normal and wide boards keep their current sizing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: compact fit path gains a height branch; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save change; layout: the tall frame becomes 283px wide at 390, leaving whitespace, and the game foot may sit just below the fold.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure fitBoardWidth mobile cases, 390/320 before/after measurements, a played Confluence clear at 390 and 320, desktop regression geometry and the 18-level run.
